gloss: one by one; in detail; point by point

definitions.gloss: one by one; item by item; in detail
definitions.explanation: Addressing or examining each item individually without omitting any. Often used for reports or explanations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逐一|ちくいち}⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逐一|ちくいち}⟦{検討|けんとう}した→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: We examined the problems one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逐一|ちくいち}⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His every move is being monitored.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{逐|ちく} (pursue, one by one) + ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逐一|ちくいち}⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ - to report in detail
- {逐一|ちくいち}⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ - to explain point by point
- {逐一|ちくいち}⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧ - to examine one by one
- {逐一|ちくいち}⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ - to record every detail

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly used in business, academic, and official contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逐次|ちくじ}→逐次：17550_chikuji⟧ - sequentially, successively (emphasizes order)
- ⟦{一々|いちいち}→一々：08946_ichiichi⟧ - one by one (more colloquial, can be critical)
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - in detail
